title: Discrete derivative of a sign monomial
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $i$ be a coordinate of the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $S$ be a set of coordinates, and let $x$ be a point of the cube. The discrete derivative in coordinate $i$ of the sign monomial indexed by $S$, evaluated at $x$, equals the monomial indexed by $S\setminus\{i\}$ if $i\in S$, and equals $0$ otherwise.
